target: 579 Transitus Energiae

source: 579 Energy Passage
target: 579 Transitus Energiae

source: On the betrothal boat, the humanoid Sealed Artifact ascended, her form suspended in the air.
target: In nave sponsali, artifactum sigillatum humanoide ascendit, forma eius in aere suspendens.

source: Striding through the atmosphere, she advanced toward the sailboat.
target: Per aēr ambulans, navim velariam petivit.

source: With the weight akin to a massive stone sphere, she manipulated the surrounding space, causing the target ship to shift automatically.
target: Cum pondere, quod ingenti sphaera lapidea simile apparuit, spatium circumjacentem regnavit, quo navis destinata automatice commutata est.

source: The two factions drew near.
target: Duae factiones appropinquaverunt.

source: Concurrently, the vacant eyes of the humanoid Sealed Artifact, adorned in a black nun’s attire, suddenly sparked with madness and chaos.
target: Simul, oculi vacui artifacti sigillati humanoide, habitu monialis nigrae induti, subito insanitate et tumultu exarduerunt.

source: Minute blood vessels protruded from the whites of its eyes, swiftly converging.
target: Minutae venae sanguinis ex albis oculorum eminuerunt, celeriter confluentes.

source: Accompanying her “affliction,” the Maidens of the Sea, deputy hosts, and sailors on the betrothal ship, unaware of what transpired, stood motionless.
target: Comitantes eius “afflictioni”, Puellae Maris, ministri vicarii, et nautae in nave sponsali, nescii quid evenisset, immobiliter steterunt.

source: Their expressions blank, eyes vacant, they succumbed to the same state as the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
target: Vultus eorum inani, oculi vacui, in eundem statum artifacti sigillati humanoide ceciderunt.

source: In that moment, within the lingering Light of Holiness on the sailboat, which had traversed the void and approached the origin of Derangement, a light abruptly vanished, swallowed by the profound darkness.
target: In illo momento, intra manentem Lucem Sanctitatis in nave velaria, quae vacuum peragraverat et ad originem insaniae accesserat, lumen subito evanuit, ab imis tenebris devoratum.

source: In the darkness, a tranquil voice resonated, as if reciting a beautiful poem.
target: In tenebris, vox tranquilla resonavit, quasi pulchrum carmen recitaret.

source: The expression of the humanoid Sealed Artifact softened significantly.
target: Vultus artifacti sigillati humanoide significanter mollitus est.

source: The chaos and madness in her eyes dissipated, and her steps slowed.
target: Chaos et insania in oculis eius evanuerunt, et gressus eius tardaverunt.

source: The other individuals on the betrothal ship also entered a state of tranquility and drowsiness.
target: Ceteri in nave sponsali quoque in statum tranquillitatis et soporis inciderunt.

source: Juan Oro felt the intangible force suppressing his body instantly dissipate.
target: Juan Oro sensit vim intangibilem, quae corpus eius opprimebat, celeriter evanuisse.

source: Straightening up abruptly, he glared angrily at Simon Guiaro, positioned at the bow of the ship.
target: Subito se reficiens, iracunde spectavit ad Simon Guiaro, qui in prora navis stabat.

source: The president of the Fisheries Guild had a rough idea of the other party’s identity.
target: Praeses Gremii Piscationis quandam ideam de identitate alterius partis habebat.

source: After all, not many comprehended the entire sea prayer ritual and knew the intricacies of the Ring of the Sea Queen.
target: Postremo, pauci totum ritum precationis maris comprehenderunt et subtilitates Anuli Reginae Maris noverunt.

source: Combined with the fact that he hailed from the same family as Simon Guiaro, there was only one answer: Lato Guiaro!
target: Cum et de eadem familia originem haberet cum Simone Guiaro, sola responsio erat: Lato Guiaro!

source: “You traitor!” Even the distant chanting from the darkness couldn’t pacify Juan Oro’s anger.
target: “Proditor!” Ne etiam cantus remoti ex tenebris iram Juan Oro sedare potuit.

source: Although no longer the temporary Governor of the Sea, he still possessed considerable strength and could be deemed formidable at sea.
target: Quamquam iam non erat gubernator temporarius maris, tamen vires significantes habebat et in mari formidabilis existimabatur.

source: Splash!
target: Splash!

source: The seawater at the bottom of the betrothal ship surged, part of it threatening to hurl everyone back to the surface, while others formed into towering peaks and crashed down on Lato Guiaro, masquerading as Simon Guiaro.
target: Aquam marinam in fundo navis sponsalis surrexit; pars eius omnes ad superficiem verberari minabatur, dum aliae in cacumina excelsa congregatae in Lato Guiaro, qui ut Simon Guiaro se ostendebat, corruerunt.

source: Lato abruptly pivoted, fixing his gaze on Juan Oro.
target: Lato subito se vertit, oculos in Juan Oro consuens.

source: The azure “peak” poised to strike him froze in midair, its descent arrested.
target: Cacumen caeruleum, paratum ad eum feriendum, in aere suspenditum sistit, descensum eius coercens.

source: The water’s attempt to push the betrothal ship out of this area also ceased its endeavors.
target: Conatus aquae navem sponsalem ex hac regione proiciendi quoque cessavit.

source: Reflected in Lato Guiaro’s eyes was the figure of Juan Oro.
target: In oculis Lato Guiaro imago Juan Oro reflecta erat.

source: The corners of his mouth curled up slightly as he stated a fact in a composed tone, “I am now the Governor of the Sea.”
target: Anguli oris eius leviter incurvati sunt, dum rem certam leni voce declaravit: “Nunc gubernator maris sum.”

source: “Your abilities, especially those affecting these waters, are completely suppressed by me. They are useless!
target: ‘Virtutes tuae, praesertim quae has aquas afficiunt, a me omnino suppressae sunt. Inutiles sunt!’

source: The incantation from the darkness targeted the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
target: Incantatio ex tenebris artifactum sigillatum humanoide destinavit.

source: Everything else was secondary.
target: Omnia alia erant secundaria.

source: As the interim Governor of the Sea, Lato Guiaro couldn’t help but be affected.
target: Ut gubernator interim maris, Lato Guiaro inevitabiliter affectus est.

source: However, thanks to the feedback from the sea and the sharing of the burden, it didn’t reach a profound level.
target: Attamen, propter responsionem maris et oneris communiationem, effectus non profundus factus est.

source: He only became more tranquil, devoid of the desire for intense combat and direct killing.
target: Ipse tantum magis tranquillus factus est, desiderio pugnandi intensi et caedis directa carens.

source: Compared to Juan Oro, he was more concerned about whether Gandalf was on the sailboat besides Hela.
target: Ad Juan Oro comparatus, magis curabat utrum Gandalf, praeter Hela, in nave velaria adesset.

source: He was more concerned about whether Mad Lady had opened the spaceship’s passageway in time.
target: Magis curabat utrum Mad Lady iter navis sideralis tempore aperuisset.

source: Juan Oro’s heart sank as he witnessed the azure wave suspended in midair and Lato Guiaro, seemingly indifferent to him.
target: Cor Juan Oro defluit, dum unda caerulea in aere suspendita atque Lato Guiaro, quasi ad eum indifferens, conspiceret.

source: At that moment, Lato turned to Mad Lady, who had reverted to her human form, and addressed his companion, clad in an unusually flamboyant blood-colored dress,
target: Eo in momento, Lato se vertit ad Mad Lady, quae ad formam humanam redierat, et comitem suum alloquitur, induta veste sanguinea insolita.

source: “Hurry up.”
target: Festina.

source: Mad Lady wasn’t particularly tall, standing at over 1.6 meters.
target: Mad Lady non nimis alta erat, stans plus quam 1.6 metra.

source: Her dark-blond hair was disheveled, influenced by the heaviness effect.
target: Eius capilli, nigro-flavi, inordinati erant, effectu gravitatis affecti.

source: None of it fluttered wantonly, pointing towards the seabed.
target: Nullus capillorum eius leviter volitabat, sed ad fundum maris tendebat.

source: Her face concealed by pure flesh, making it challenging to discern her original appearance.
target: Vultus eius, carne pura opertus, formam originariam eius difficile patefaciebat.

source: She wore a ring on each hand.
target: In utraque manu annulum gerebat.

source: On her left hand, there was a rose-gold ring embedded with a gem resembling crimson blood, and on her right, a simple, pure silver ring.
target: In manu sinistra, annulus auro rosa tinctus, gemma rubra quasi sanguine apparens insita erat; in manu dextra, annulus simplex et argenteus purus erat.

source: Mad Lady responded to Lato Guiaro with a smile, “So there are times when you’re anxious.”
target: Mad Lady respondit Lato Guiaro subrisu: “Sic sunt tempora, cum anxius sis.”

source: Only then did she cast her gaze at the silver-gray behemoth embedded in the seabed not far away.
target: Tum solum oculos suos ad monstrum argenteo-canum, prope in fundo maris insitum, convertit.

source: This lunatic… Lato Guiaro cursed inwardly.
target: Hic insanus… Lato Guiaro intus maledixit.

source: I Know Someone had an extremely nasty personality and subsequently succumbed to mental illness due to other reasons and was admitted to an asylum, but in contrast, Mad Lady had displayed an abnormal state of mind from the very beginning.
target: I Know Someone personalitatem valde nefariam habebat, et deinde propter alias causas insaniam mentis cedere coactus, et in asylum admitte est; contra vero, Mad Lady ab initio statum mentis anormalem ostendit.

source: In the past, she relied on I Know Someone’s regular treatment to barely maintain her rationality, but now, she was becoming more and more insane.
target: Priore tempore, illa curationi regulari a I Know Someone innitebatur, ut vix rationalitatem retineret, sed nunc magis atque magis insanissima fiebat.

source: Lato Guiaro took a deep breath, focusing on the peculiar sounds emanating from within the spaceship, resisting the distant chants echoing in the darkness.
target: Lato Guiaro profundum spiritum accepit, sonis peculiariis ex interiore nave siderali emittentibus intendens, ac cantionibus remotis in tenebris resonantibus resistere conatus est.

source: Swiftly regaining his will to fight, he redirected his gaze to the sailboat, raising his right arm.
target: Celeriter pugnandi ardorem rursus accipiens, oculos suos ad navem velariam redirigit, dextrum brachium levans.

source: Upon witnessing this, Juan Oro’s sense of despair deepened.
target: Hoc videns, desperatio Juan Oro profundius facta est.

source: The white-haired old man clenched his fist, slamming it against his chest.
target: Senex albi capillatus pugnum contraxit, et in pectus suum feriens.

source: With a snap, his sternum broke, and his flesh tore open, releasing a torrent of blood that painted his body and the betrothal ship’s deck red.
target: Cum sonitu, sternum eius confractum est, et caro eius lacerata, torrentem sanguinis effundens, qui corpus eius et tabulam navis sponsalis rubrum effinxit.

source: As life ebbed away, Juan Oro’s white hair defied the heaviness effect, floating upwards.
target: Dum vita defluebat, albi capilli Juan Oro effectui gravitatis repugnabant, sursum levitantes.

source: His steps grew burdensome, each movement pressing down like a mountain on the ground.
target: Gressus eius onerosi erant, omnis motus quasi mons in terram premebat.

source: Just as Lato Guiaro was poised to unleash the surrounding seawater, submerging the sailboat, he suddenly realized that the sea wasn’t as obedient as before.
target: Iam cum Lato Guiaro paratus esset circumjacentem aquam marinam dimittere, navem velariam submergendo, repente intellexit mare non tam obtemperare quam prius.

source: His Governor of the Sea position teetered on the brink of collapse.
target: Positio gubernatoris maris eius ad ruinae limen vacilabat.

source: Lato Guiaro turned his head once more, narrowing his eyes at Juan Oro, now covered in blood.
target: Lato Guiaro iterum caput vertit, oculos contrahens in Juan Oro, qui nunc sanguine operitus erat.

source: “Traitor, the sea will punish you!” Juan Oro’s dark-green eyes focused, emitting a beam of blue light.
target: “Proditor, mare te puniet!” oculi eius virides obscuri Juan Oro fixos habebant, radium lucis caeruleae emittens.

source: Accompanying this attack, he also intensified Lato Guiaro’s heaviness, rendering him unable to move normally.
target: Comitans hoc impetum, etiam pondus Lato Guiaro augebat, ita ut movere recte non posset.

source: Two beams struck Lato Guiaro simultaneously, penetrating him and sinking into the sea.
target: Duo radii simul Lato Guiaro percusserunt, eum penetrantes et in mare submergentes.

source: Lato Guiaro’s aura weakened slightly, but he wasn’t as severely injured as Juan Oro believed.
target: Aura Lato Guiaro leviter debilitata est, sed non tam graviter vulneratus erat quam Juan Oro credidit.

source: Sunlight burst forth from the April Fool key member who used “Ultraman” as his code name, eradicating the residual corrosive powers and altering his body structure.
target: Lux solis ex membro clavi Aprilis Folli, qui “Ultraman” ut codicem suum utebatur, effulsit, residuas vires corrosivas excidens atque configurationem corporis mutans.

source: He lifted his chin slightly and uttered three words with strange pronunciations.
target: Mentum suum leviter sublevavit et tria verba cum insolitis pronuntiis edixit.

source: This was also the language employed to activate the spaceship.
target: Haec etiam erat lingua ad navem sideralem activandam adhibita.

source: The implication was likely akin to granting access, equivalent to obtaining a certain amount of Governor of the Sea power without “melding” with the sea after opening a crack in the seal.
target: Implicatio verisimiliter erat similis ad concedendum accessum, id est, ut quaedam potentia gubernatoris maris obtineretur, sine “coniunctione” cum mari, postquam fissura in sigillo aperta est.

source: Lato Guiaro’s usage now was to help him seize all authority back from Juan Oro.
target: Usus Lato Guiaro nunc erat ut totam auctoritatem a Juan Oro sibi restitueret.

source: Hmph, foolish fellow, a group of fools.
target: Hem, stulte homo, caterva stultorum.

source: They hadn’t studied the sounds heard during every sea sacrifice after so many years.
target: Non studuerunt sonos, qui in omni sacrificio maris per tot annos auditi erant.

source: They guarded the treasure but failed to excavate it!
target: Thesaurum custodiabant, sed illud effodere defecerunt!

source: Sacrificing your life? Sacrificing yourself?
target: Vitam tuam sacrificare? Te ipsum sacrificare?

source: It’s meaningless!
target: Nihil valet!

source: Brains and strength are the foundation!
target: Mens et vis fundamentum sunt!

source: Juan Oro, still bleeding from his chest, was surprised to discover that the authority of the Governor of the Sea had shifted again.
target: Juan Oro, adhuc ex pectore sanguinans, miratus est quod auctoritas gubernatoris maris iterum versa esset.

source: He stared at Lato Guiaro in confusion and horror, as if looking at a true devil.
target: Illum intuitus est Lato Guiaro, in confusione et horrore, quasi verum diabolum.

source: Why? Why does the sea favor him more?
target: Cur? Cur mare eum magis praeferat?

source: Why does the sea favor this traitor more?
target: Cur mare hunc proditorem magis praeferat?

source: At that moment, Mad Lady, on the other side of the bow, completed reciting the incoherent order.
target: In illo momento, Mad Lady, in altera parte prorae, ordinem incoherentem recitare perfecit.

source: The silver-gray behemoth at the bottom of the sea trembled slightly, increasing in magnitude, causing the entire seabed and all the seawater to quake.
target: Monstrum argenteo-canum in fundo maris leviter tremuit, magnitudine augens, totum substratum maris atque omnem aquam concutiens.

source: Inside, beams of pure light converged and shot out from the open entrance, landing at the edge of the betrothal ship, forming a transparent tunnel-like energy passageway.
target: Intus, radii lucis purae convergentes e porta aperta proiecerunt, ad margines navis sponsalis delapsi, formantes transeuntem viam energiae quasi tunnel translucidus.

source: Mad Lady didn’t immediately leap into the pure light.
target: Mad Lady non statim in lucem puram insiluit.

source: She understood that as the spaceship opened and activated further, the power accumulated in the depths of the seal would erupt.
target: Intellegebat quod, dum navis sideralis aperiretur et ulterius activaretur, potentia in profundis sigilli collecta erumpere posset.

source: Everyone present, except the Governor of the Sea, would be torn apart.
target: Omnes praesentes, excepto gubernatore maris, dilacerabuntur.

source: But it didn’t matter.
target: Sed nihil refert.

source: She had a solution.
target: Illa remedium habebat.

source: The plain silver ring on her right hand, a gift from Bard, held the boon from honoring the ancestors.
target: Annulus argenteus simplex in manu dextra eius, donum a Bard, beneficium maiorum honorandorum tenebat.

source: It could steal that power and distribute it, sharing the burden with all the Children of the Sea in Port Santa.
target: Illud potentiam rapere et distribuere poterat, onus cum omnibus Filiorum Maris in Port Santa communicans.

source: Of course, those present would receive more.
target: Certe, illi praesentes amplius acciperent.

source: Whether they could endure it or not depended on fate.
target: Utrum id ferre possent an non, fato pendebat.

source: When the moment arrived, the Fisheries Guild members would believe the sea prayer ritual had succeeded, celebrating with joy.
target: Cum momentum advenisset, membra Gremii Piscationis crediderunt ritum precationis maris feliciter effectum esse, et cum gaudio celebraverunt.

source: Little did they know that their “sea” had been stolen.
target: Parum sciebant quod eorum “mare” sublatum esset.

source: The irony delighted Mad Lady.
target: Ironia Mad Lady delectavit.

source: Just as she was about to use the ring, a strong sense of Danger Premonition hit her.
target: Iam, dum annulum uti pararetur, potens sensus praemonitionis periculi eam percussit.

source: In a flash, her figure vanished, reappearing a few steps away.
target: In momento, figura eius evanuit, et paucis passibus ultra iterum apparuit.

source: A shadow rose from the deck where she had stood, but it failed to envelop her.
target: Umbra ex ponte, ubi steterat, surrexit, sed eam complecti non potuit.

source: Mad Lady then spotted Mr. K, draped in a blood-colored cloak and hood, and Lumian Lee, wearing the Lie earring but yet to revert to his original appearance.
target: Mad Lady deinde Dominum K animadvertit, in pallio sanguineo colore induto et galea, atque Lumian Lee, auriculis “Lie” gestantem, sed nondum ad formam originariam redactum.

source: Port Santa, Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Port Santa, sedes gubernatoris maris.

source: Bard stood by the window, gazing at the weeds outside.
target: Bard iuxta fenestram stabat, et herbas extra intuens.

source: Silently calculating the time, he waited for the sea prayer ritual to progress.
target: Tacite tempus computans, exspectabat ut rituum precationis maris progrediretur.

source: If the sea’s boon arrived with a delay and cheers erupted from Milo Village, he would openly leave this place, abandoning those who had been deceived.
target: Si beneficium maris sero advenerit et cantus ex vico Milo eruptus fuerit, hunc locum aperte reliqueret, eos qui decepti fuerant derelinquens.

source: When the moment arrived, anyone attempting to stop him would be torn apart by the power of the sea.
target: Quando momentum advenisset, quicumque eum sistere conaretur, vi maris dilacerabuntur.

source: In the absence of a delayed collective boon, but with the sky and sea undergoing ominous changes, as if a catastrophe had struck, Bard could wait for the spaceship or Mad Lady to pick him up.
target: In absentia beneficii collectivi serotinii, sed cum caelum et mare mutationes ominosas subeunt, quasi calamitas accidisset, Bard exspectare poterat ut navis sideralis aut Mad Lady eum sublevaret.

source: Of course, he wouldn’t wait indefinitely.
target: Certe, indefinitim exspectare non poterat.

source: If there were no further developments from the sea prayer ritual within ten minutes, he would use his abilities to forcefully exit, shift positions, and conceal himself.
target: Si intra decem minuta nulla nova ex rito precationis maris evenisset, facultates suas ad exitum vi compellendum, ad locos mutandos, et ad se celandos adhiberet.

source: The early-stage abilities of the Marauder pathway weren’t formidable.
target: Facultates initii viae raptorum non erant formidabiles.

source: Bard had developed the habit of remaining vigilant as he advanced step by step.
target: Bard consuetudinem evolverat ut vigilans maneret dum gradatim progrediebatur.

source: As the weeds swayed in the bright sunlight and mild wind, Bard suddenly heard faint footsteps.
target: Dum herbae in lumine claro et vento miti oscillabantur, Bard subito passus leves audivit.

source: The sound emanated from the corridor outside, so subtle that it seemed almost like an illusion.
target: Sonus ex corridori foris emanabat, tam subtilis ut paene ut illusio videretur.
